items.name: ai-versioning
items.label: Five model versions stacked; the newest is live, and the one under the pointer slides out to be rolled back to.

items.name: applications-rules
items.label: A stack of five rule slabs, each with a criteria block and a behaviour block; the slab under the pointer lifts as the match and the rules above it step aside.

items.name: azion-404
items.label: Page not found: the Azion mark hovers over its empty slot and never lands.

items.name: bot-lineup
items.label: A lineup of visitors, round-headed humans and square-headed bots; the one under the pointer steps forward and says which it is.

items.name: build-terminal
items.label: A terminal with six lines of code and a prompt; the line under the pointer lifts off the slab.

items.name: cache-ttl
items.label: A grid of cache slots; the pointer warms the ones it touches and each cools down again after its time to live.

items.name: certificates-chain
items.label: A root, an intermediate and a leaf certificate stacked on thin posts; the pointer walks the verification mark along the chain and the slabs it passes lift in turn.

items.name: connectors-link
items.label: An edge block linked to three origins by dashed lines; the origin under the pointer connects and a packet travels to it.

items.name: custom-pages-status
items.label: Four upright error pages in a row; the pointer picks one, which tilts forward and lights up while its neighbours lean away.

items.name: ddos-flood
items.label: Traffic piles up under the pointer, but every column is capped; what rises above the line is absorbed.

items.name: deployments-release
items.label: Five release slabs along a timeline; the pointer lifts one and the live mark travels to it, promoting or rolling back.

items.name: dns-lookup
items.label: A name server tree; pointing at a leaf lifts the lookup path from the root down through its zone, one hop after another.

items.name: functions-invoke
items.label: A function block at the back of a pad with five request lanes in front; the lane under the pointer sends its request in and the block lifts to run it.

items.name: image-variants
items.label: One photo at four sizes; the variant under the pointer lifts off the pad and says its width.

items.name: infra-workloads
items.label: A cluster of nodes, each as tall as its load; a workload hops to the node under the pointer and lands.

items.name: lb-rotor
items.label: A rotor with four backend outlets; the arm follows the pointer and snaps onto the nearest outlet.

items.name: metrics-gauge
items.label: A gauge whose needle follows the pointer across its scale, lighting the ticks it has passed.

items.name: network-lists-gate
items.label: A field of address tiles in front of a gate bar; sweeping the pointer across a tile flips it between allowed and denied, and it stays that way.

items.name: object-storage-bucket
items.label: An open bucket tray holding six objects of different sizes; the one under the pointer lifts out and its neighbours settle apart.

items.name: observe-stream
items.label: A stream of events on a rail, errors standing taller; hovering slows time and the event under the pointer says what it is.

items.name: orchestrator-scale
items.label: Eight node slots on a pad; moving the pointer along it sets how many nodes are provisioned, and they rise in order.

items.name: platform-edge
items.label: A user on the ground, five edge nodes and a distant origin; the edge nearest the pointer lifts and serves the request.

items.name: secure-shield
items.label: A shield over a matrix of requests; blocked ones stand as blocks, allowed ones lie flat, and the one under the pointer says its verdict.

items.name: store-replicas
items.label: A primary database and four empty replica slots; the replica under the pointer fills disc by disc until it is in sync.

items.name: variables-keys
items.label: A grid of key blocks, each with a flat masked value beside it; the key under the pointer lights and raises its value.
